chunk_title: Section 1. Conduct of Regular and Special CPD Council Meeting/s.
retrieval_text:
Section 1. Conduct of Regular and Special CPD Council Meeting/s.
The CPD Council shall meet at least twice a month for the purpose of evaluating CPD-related applications for accreditation. Special meetings may likewise be called at the instance of the CPD Council Chairperson, or upon written request of any Member of the CPD Council submitted at least three (3) days prior to the requested date of the meeting.
full_entry_text:
Section 1. Conduct of Regular and Special CPD Council Meeting/s.
The CPD Council shall meet at least twice a month for the purpose of evaluating CPD-related applications for accreditation. Special meetings may likewise be called at the instance of the CPD Council Chairperson, or upon written request of any Member of the CPD Council submitted at least three (3) days prior to the requested date of the meeting.

chunk_title: Section 2. Filing and Processing of Applications, and Requirements for Accreditation of CPD Providers and their CPD Programs.
retrieval_text:
Section 2. Filing and Processing of Applications, and Requirements for Accreditation of CPD Providers and their CPD Programs.
The period for filing and processing of applications, and the list of documentary requirements for accreditation of CPD Providers and their CPD Programs as stipulated in Commission Resolution No. 1948 (s. 2025), or the "Revised Guidelines on the Processing of Applications for Accreditation of Continuing Professional Development Providers and their CPD Programs", are hereby adopted.

chunk_title: Section 3. Major Areas of CPD Activities.
retrieval_text:
Section 3. Major Areas of CPD Activities.
The CPD activities of the professionals shall be divided into two (2) major areas with the corresponding percentage of credit units (CUs) based on the required number of CUs per compliance period. The coverage of each major area shall include, but not limited to:

Major Area 1
Major Area: Ethics and Values
Coverage of the Area: Ethics, values, and attitude
Required Units: 10% of required CUs per compliance period

Major Area 2
Major Area: Enhancement of Professional Practice and Competence
Coverage of the Area: Clinical trends and best practices, academic and clinical instruction, research and evidence-based practice, leadership and management, Speech-Language Pathology in public health, policy development, community-based practice, and others
Required Units: 90% of required CUs per compliance period
full_entry_text:
Section 3. Major Areas of CPD Activities.
The CPD activities of the professionals shall be divided into two (2) major areas with the corresponding percentage of credit units (CUs) based on the required number of CUs per compliance period. The coverage of each major area shall include, but not limited to:

Major Area 1 (Ethics and Values): Required Units = 10% of required CUs per compliance period. Coverage: Ethics, values, and attitude.
Major Area 2 (Enhancement of Professional Practice and Competence): Required Units = 90% of required CUs per compliance period. Coverage: Clinical trends and best practices, academic and clinical instruction, research and evidence-based practice, leadership and management, Speech-Language Pathology in public health, policy development, community-based practice, and others.
source_document: PRB-SLP Resolution No. 02, Series of 2025 - Operational Guidelines on CPD Program for SLPs

retrieval_text:
Section 4. Compliance to Post-Conduct Requirements.
Accredited CPD Providers must submit a Completion Report and all its supporting documents as provided under Annex B-9 of Commission Resolution No. 1244 (s. 2020), otherwise known as "Guidelines on the Matrix of Continuing Professional Development (CPD) Activities, Revised CPD Forms and CPD Glossary" within thirty (30) calendar days after the conduct of the accredited CPD Program. Likewise, attendance sheets using the prescribed template shall be uploaded in the CPD Accreditation System (CPDAS) within ten (10) calendar days after the conduct of the accredited CPD program. Non-compliance to post-conduct requirements shall cause the denial of succeeding CPD Program applications for accreditation.
full_entry_text:
Section 4. Compliance to Post-Conduct Requirements.
Accredited CPD Providers must submit a Completion Report and all its supporting documents as provided under Annex B-9 of Commission Resolution No. 1244 (s. 2020), otherwise known as "Guidelines on the Matrix of Continuing Professional Development (CPD) Activities, Revised CPD Forms and CPD Glossary" within thirty (30) calendar days after the conduct of the accredited CPD Program. Likewise, attendance sheets using the prescribed template shall be uploaded in the CPD Accreditation System (CPDAS) within ten (10) calendar days after the conduct of the accredited CPD program. Non-compliance to post-conduct requirements shall cause the denial of succeeding CPD Program applications for accreditation.
